spots.name: Plan B
spots.description: A cool cafe and breakfast spot with a co-working space, fast Wi-Fi, and air conditioning. They serve excellent coffee with free cookies and outstanding chicken fajita hoppers. Great for digital nomads and breakfast lovers.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: They give you a free bicki, which is always a vibe for me. And they also have the most amazing chicken fajita hoppers.

thingsToKnow: Co-working space costs extra but is air conditioned with really fast Wi-Fi

spots.name: Nomads
spots.description: A cafe with really good coffee and breakfast. Their pumpkin toast with eggs was highly rated, and they also serve a delicious shock shake (smoothie).

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: They have really good coffee, really good brekie. Whilst we were there, we had their pumpkin toast with eggs and it was 10 out of 10.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: Next up is Nomad Cafe. I think is the whole group's favorite cafe over here because the food is just outstanding and this is a great spot to work from.

spots.name: Shady Lane
spots.description: An Australian-owned breakfast spot in Mirissa with a really cool funky fit out. You can make your own eggs and it's reasonably priced. They serve items like chia and mango pudding and sell clothes too.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: The breakfast was amazing. You can make your own eggs and it's reasonably priced. It's a really cool funky fit out. You can buy clothes there.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: Shady Lane is something that I have had my eye on for a very long time...they have an incredible menu of vegetarian and vegan food all their dishes are really tasty

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: I'm here at the Shady Lane, which is a cafe in Mirissa, and uh starting with some breakfast.

thingsToKnow: More reasonably priced than Plan B

spots.name: Mucci Coffee House
spots.description: A coffee house right near accommodation in Weligama, very close to the beach. Offers good breakfast and coffee.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: Really enjoyed was Mucci which was right near our accommodation and really close to the beach.

spots.name: Sri Lankan Traditional Food
spots.description: A local breakfast shack right next to Plan B run by three lovely ladies. Serves authentic Sri Lankan breakfast with hoppers, eggs, veggie rolls, rotty, and coconut items. Cheap and highly authentic.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: It just kind of looks like a shack and it's got like three lovely cute little ladies behind cooking brekie. Breakfast is cheap. It cost us 900 rupee between the both of us for a big awesome breakfast.

thingsToKnow: Come at 8 or 9am when it's less busy, as workers come early before their shifts
Very cheap at 900 rupees for two people

spots.name: Kai Beach Club
spots.description: A big beach club in Weligama opposite Nomads with a DJ all day, massive pool, and direct beach access. They organize surf lessons and have three restaurants. Great for spending the whole day relaxing with cocktails and food on bean bags.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: It has a DJ all day, massive pool, it's on the beach. They organize surf lessons as well. You can just pitch up for the whole day on some bean bags, drink some cocktails, eat some food there.

spots.name: Petty Petty
spots.description: A beach club in Mirissa with a pool right on the beach, good cocktails, and a nice vibe with music. They have activities at night and are great for day visits.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: This also has a pool. It's right on the beach. It uh has some pretty good cocktails. You know, the music is playing. It's really cool.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: We ended up spending most of our time at this place called Petty Petty, which is like a beach club. So, you have beach access. They had this swing, which was really nice.

spots.name: Tennis Beach Club
spots.description: A really chill beach club in Ahangama with bean bags to sit and watch the beach and ocean. They have tasty cocktails and serve toast/puppets with toppings. Good for spending a full day relaxing.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: This one was really chill. You come down there, they've got bean bags that you can sit there and watch the beach and the ocean. The cocktails were really tasty.

spots.name: The Cliff
spots.description: A beautiful restaurant in Weligama with stunning ocean views where waves crash onto rocks. The food is pretty good and the whole scenic experience is amazing, especially for sunset dining.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: It's called the cliff in Weligama and it's just got the most beautiful views you will ever see. The waves are crashing onto the rocks. It was just so scenic and lovely.

thingsToKnow: Book a table in advance, they recommend the 5:30 PM sitting

spots.name: Dal Nether
spots.description: A local restaurant tucked away in a side street in Weligama. Serves rice and curry, hoppers, and pumpkin curry. Really tasty and authentic local dining.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: This is tucked away in a little side street and we ordered rice and curry and they brought out hoppers and it was just really yum. Really yummy pumpkin curry as well.

spots.name: The Slow
spots.description: An all-vegan restaurant in Mirissa right on the beach with a laid-back dinner vibe. You sit on bean bags overlooking the beach, making it a really nice relaxed dining experience.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: This is all vegan and it's just on the beach. So if you want a really cool laid-back dinner overlooking the beach while sitting on a bean bag, it's a really nice vibe.

spots.name: Curry Geta
spots.description: A curry house in Mirissa with outstanding buffet-style dining offering many different curries, rice, and pappadums. Very affordable and includes free dessert. Great for value and authentic local food.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: It this meal was outstanding. We stumbled across this and it's buffet style. There's just so much choice of different curries and rice and papa dums.

thingsToKnow: Buffet style
3000 rupees for two people (1500 each, about $7.50)
Includes free dessert

spots.name: Rice and Spoon
spots.description: A beautiful family-owned restaurant in Mirissa that looks like someone's backyard. Offers buffet-style authentic Sri Lankan food with rice and curries. The owners and their kids are incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating a familial dining experience.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: This beautiful family owned restaurant called Rice and Spoon. It wasn't quite ready. But it's buffet style again. And they started bringing out all the different rices and the curries. And it was just so nice.

thingsToKnow: Buffet style
1500 rupees per person (about $7.50)
Includes free dessert
Come early as it gets busy
Very authentic and friendly family atmosphere

spots.name: Weligama Beach
spots.description: A beautiful beach best for beginner surfers. You can walk the whole stretch of the beach in the mornings or afternoons, making it great for exploring and surfing lessons.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: First, you have Wagama. And it's the best for beginner surfers. Also, we loved Wagama because you could walk the whole stretch of the beach.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: I spent most of my time here recently around the Wellagama area, which based on how many people are there, is the hippiest and coolest spot to be.

thingsToKnow: Best for beginner surfers
Very crowded with dozens of other surfers and 50-60 surf schools operating on the beach
Best visited between November and April for optimal south coast conditions

spots.name: Mirissa Beach
spots.description: Probably the most famous beach on the south coast of Sri Lanka. Extremely Instagrammable with beautiful scenery and home to Coconut Tree Hill nearby, which is ideal for watching sunsets.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: Then you have Marissa and this is probably the most famous beach in the south of Sri Lanka. It is very Instagrammable.

spots.name: Coconut Tree Hill
spots.description: An extremely Instagrammable viewpoint near Mirissa Beach that is a beautiful place to watch the sunset. One of the most scenic spots in the area.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: And then you have Coconut Tree Hill which is extremely Instagrammable and a really beautiful place to watch the sunset.

spots.name: Ahangama Beach
spots.description: A beach for more intermediate surfers with reef breaks. You can also walk along this beach but it's not as good as Weligama for beach walks.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: And then finally you have Aangama and this is for more intermediate surfers. So if you do know how to surf, you can head out here. There's some more reef breaks.

thingsToKnow: Best for intermediate to advanced surfers with reef breaks

spots.name: Weligama Airbnb near Mucci Coffee
spots.description: An Airbnb in Weligama located next to Mucci Coffee House with a cool aesthetic, nice Wi-Fi, and outdoor space. It's only a 2-minute walk to the beach and cost the creators $400 for seven nights.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: We stayed in this Airbnb. It only cost us about $400 for seven nights. It was really well priced, and we had it had really cool aesthetic, nice Wi-Fi, a nice space out the front. You could just walk 2 minutes to the beach.

thingsToKnow: $400 for 7 nights
2 minutes walk to beach

spots.name: Surf Lessons
spots.description: Surf lessons available at Weligama Beach for beginner surfers. You can negotiate the price directly with instructors on the beach.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: So number one is a surf lesson, and you can do that for about $10 to $20. Just negotiate the price with the guys on the beach.

thingsToKnow: Negotiate price with instructors on the beach

spots.name: Whale Watching Tours
spots.description: Whale watching boat tours available from the south coast. Not guaranteed to see whales but offers good chances of seeing whales and dolphins.

mentions.videoTitle: Weligama, Mirissa & Ahangama | Sri Lanka’s Surf Coast Travel Guide 🇱🇰
mentions.quote: Then you can do whale watching, and you can pay for a trip. These cost about 30 USD, and it's not guaranteed you see a whale, but we were hanging out with a couple last night, and they saw whales and dolphins.

thingsToKnow: Cost about $30 USD
Not guaranteed to see whales

spots.name: Blue Waves
spots.description: A beachfront accommodation in the Weligama area with waves right out front. The creator stayed here for most of his trip and praised the owners for having the best coffee in the area and a really cool location for surfing.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: I stayed at Blue Waves pretty much the entire time and loved it. The guys have the best coffee by far in the area and a really cool location with waves right out front.

spots.name: Hikkaduwa
spots.description: A surf spot on the west side of Sri Lanka's south coast where the creator stayed 13 years prior. He returned to check it out and found it has changed significantly but still has some good waves to offer.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: Hikadua has changed a lot since I came here 13 years ago. However, there are still some really good waves around and I had a couple of nice surfs before I left.

thingsToKnow: Significantly gentrified since 13 years ago

spots.name: Kokura Surfkate House
spots.description: A recently opened training facility and hangout space for those wanting to mix up their surf routine with skateboarding training or just a place to relax. The creator described it as a really cool space for non-surfers or those looking for alternative activities.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: There's also Kokura Surfkate House, which has just opened up if you want something different and to do some training on land or just go and hang out. It's a really cool space.

spots.name: Udawalawe National Park
spots.description: A national park a couple of hours' drive from the south coast featuring abundant wildlife including elephants, birds, and crocodiles. The creator recommended it as a good activity for non-surfers or those looking to mix activities while in Sri Lanka.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: You can also drive a couple of hours to the national park nearby to check out the wildlife. Lots of elephants, some really nice birds and some crocs as well.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: a day trip to the kuma National Park is one activity that really sets arugambay apart as a surf destination...you can surf in the morning and by afternoon visit one of the most incredible national parks

spots.name: Kandy Tea Plantations
spots.description: Mountain destination reachable by famous train rides in Sri Lanka, featuring tea plantations, waterfalls, and religious sites. The creator mentioned it as a potential side trip though he was unable to visit due to flooding during his stay.

mentions.videoTitle: SURFING IN SRI LANKA - the real deal or is it over-hyped?
mentions.quote: If you've got a little bit more time, you can do some of the famous train rides in Sri Lanka into the mountains to places such as Candy to check out the tea plantations and the waterfalls and the religious sites and all the rest of it.

thingsToKnow: Subject to heavy flooding and rains during certain seasons

spots.name: Mama's Restaurant
spots.description: A popular and busy restaurant in Arugam Bay serving shawarmas and offering an amazing buffet. The place is well-recommended, reasonably priced, and known for refreshing drinks and good value for money.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: this place is quite value for money quite reasonably priced refreshing drinks and...they do have an amazing uh Buffet as well

thingsToKnow: The restaurant is very busy and popular, so expect crowds.

spots.name: Salty Swammies
spots.description: A must-visit coffee shop in Arugam Bay with amazing coffee and a concise but varied menu featuring meats and unique small dishes. The place hosts events like open mics and light evening music, and serves creative dishes like tiger prawns in compound butter and beef brisket tacos.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: one thing that is an absolute must for us when we're in arugambay is stopping by salty swammies for some amazing coffee

spots.name: Integration Coffee
spots.description: A coffee shop with an array of delicious cakes and bakes that are rare to find in Arugam Bay. The creators were very excited to try goodies from here.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: another great place to get your coffee fixed coffee specializes in an array of delicious looking cakes and bakes which are rare to come by in arugambay

spots.name: Hideaway
spots.description: A lunch spot full of trees with a nice covered space and secret garden vibe that is cooler than outside. They serve diverse dishes including Korean fried chicken sandwiches and tuna and anchovy open-face sandwiches. Also hosts Thursday parties with talented jazz musicians.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: Hideway is full of trees and it's at least a few degrees cooler than when you step out into the road...it's a really nice Secret Garden Vibe

spots.name: Fins
spots.description: A nightlife venue serving delicious drinks like piña coladas, with talented performers and good music vibes. They also serve food and have rooms available. Known for hosting ladies' nights.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: we started off our Explorations Into The abay Nightlife scene with a midweek ladies night at fins they had some delicious drinks

thingsToKnow: They host ladies' nights during the week.
Rooms are available at this venue.

spots.name: Kaa Guest House
spots.description: A nice guest house located just outside the immediate strip in Arugam Bay. It utilizes local homes and provides comfortable accommodation. The property includes a café with an open mic night.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: we found Kaa which is a really nice guest house that is just outside of the immediate strip

spots.name: Self and Sun
spots.description: A property with 25 years of history and one of the first on the strip. It is very close to nature, creatively built, and offers individual villas suitable for couples and families.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: the property we're at right now is called self and sun and has been around for 25 years in fact it was one of the first properties on the Strip

spots.name: Jetwing Surf
spots.description: A luxury property about a 15-minute drive from Arugam Bay cove, offering the experience of the bay with a private retreat. Features private beach, delicious food, and full amenities.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: on the luxury and of accommodation there are properties like jet wi serve which is about a 15-minute drive from the arugam bay cob

spots.name: Bay Vista
spots.description: A property located on the cove itself with easy access to beach and cafes. Offers a variety of comfortable rooms suitable for solo, couple, and family travelers. Their restaurant serves delicious food.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: B Vista is another property we've stay that before and is a great option if you want to be located on the Cove itself

spots.name: Elephant Rock
spots.description: A fun surf spot great for morning and evening surfing, suitable for beginners and intermediates with sandy bottom and 2 to 4-foot waves. Climbing the rock for its view is popular even among non-surfers, and the sunset view of the ocean, lagoon, and sun is impeccable.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: elephant rock this is a fun spot that's great for morning and evening serve...climbing the rock for its view is really popular even amongst non Surfers

spots.name: Lighthouse Point
spots.description: The most northerly surf spot located just outside the small village and lagoon of Arugam Bay by the crumbled remains of an Old World War II Lighthouse. Better suited for experienced surfers with a boulder sand bottom and waves that get faster throughout the season.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: Lighthouse is the most Northerly spot out of the lot and is just outside the small village and Lagoon...by the crumbled remains of an Old World War II Lighthouse

spots.name: Pottuvil Point
spots.description: An intermediate surf spot just a short distance from the famous Whiskey Point (which hasn't been working since 2019). Features a mellow takeoff and shorter rides, but can be inconsistent. Best when big swell hits the east coast and rarely crowded with only 5 to 10 people.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: just a short distance from what used to be the famous whiskey Point...serves spot which unfortunately hasn't been working since 2019 is the pille point

thingsToKnow: This spot is hardly ever crowded, with only 5 to 10 people even when working.
Best visited when big swell hits the east coast.

spots.name: Peanut Farm
spots.description: A fun and popular surf spot 20 minutes outside of Arugam Bay with two peaks - one safe for beginners and one for advanced surfers. The advanced peak ranges from 3 to 8 feet and can sometimes barrel. Has cafes, restaurants, and sun beds for a full day of hanging out.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: Peanut Farm 20 minutes outside of arugambay this is another fun and popular spot...there are two peaks here one that's safe for beginners like myself

spots.name: Baby Point
spots.description: One of the most popular surf points in Arugam Bay with smaller waves suitable for beginners and intermediates. Located within the Arugam Bay cove and was one of the first spots to be developed.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: so right behind me we have baby point which is one of the most popular surf points in arugambay

spots.name: Main Point
spots.description: Another really popular surf point in Arugam Bay within the cove with bigger waves. Better suited for pro surfers or intermediate surfers. One of the first spots to be developed before branching out to other areas.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: over here we have main point which is another really popular one...main point is for Pro Surfers or intermediate surface there are bigger waves

spots.name: Kumala Monastery
spots.description: An archaeological site built in 246 BC with complex history and one of the only cylindrical dagabas to survive in Sri Lanka. Has over 200 caves to explore. Best visited in morning or early afternoon with an undeniable sense of peace at the summit.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: starting off with a visit to the kumala monastery which was built in 246 BC best visited in the morning or early afternoon

thingsToKnow: Remove footwear beyond a certain point.
Covering shoulders and knees is recommended.
Climb down before late evening as there have been leopard and elephant sightings on the rock.
The region is still very rural and home to many wildlife large and small, so always be vigilant.

spots.name: Crocodile Rock
spots.description: A large sloping rock on Kakalia beach that gets its name from resembling a crocodile from above and from real-life crocodiles lurking in the water that sometimes sunbathe on the rock. Sandwiched between beach, lagoon, lush jungles, and a wildlife hotspot that should be explored very cautiously.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: an evening visit to Crocodile Rock is one of my favorite things to do in arugam Bay this large sloping rock on kakalia beach

thingsToKnow: There are real crocodiles in the water beside and sometimes on the rock itself.
This is a wildlife hotspot used by elephants and other animals as a path.
If you find yourself on an animal path, carefully exit it for your own safety.
Male elephants in heat can be extremely aggressive and dangerous.
Lone male elephants with a strong musk smell are particularly dangerous.
Do not take selfies or videos with elephants.

spots.name: Funky Debar
spots.description: A popular spot hosting the big party of the night starting around 11:00 PM that goes until sunrise. Located in Arugam Bay and hosts parties from Thursday to Saturday in varying locations.

mentions.videoTitle: The Ultimate Guide to Arugam Bay Sri Lanka (4k)
mentions.quote: these parties happen every night from Thursday to Saturday in varying locations and today's one was at a popular spot called funky debar

thingsToKnow: Big parties start around 11:00 PM and go until sunrise.
Parties happen Thursday to Saturday.

spots.name: Arugambe Bay
spots.description: An east coast surf break that lights up during the May to October season when the south west coast is flat. It's a prime location for surfing during the eastern season.

mentions.videoTitle: Sri Lanka Surf Guide - 8 Tips To Know BEFORE You Go! 🇱🇰 (Surfing In Sri Lanka) | Stoked For Travel
mentions.quote: spots like Arugambe Bay are the way to go for that time of year uh where all the famous points light up

spots.name: Adam's Peak
spots.description: A mountain in the Hill Country that offers hikes with scenic views. The creator recommends exploring this as a non-surfing activity when visiting Sri Lanka.

mentions.videoTitle: Sri Lanka Surf Guide - 8 Tips To Know BEFORE You Go! 🇱🇰 (Surfing In Sri Lanka) | Stoked For Travel
mentions.quote: head up into the Hill Country for things like hikes at Adam's Peak

spots.name: Stoke Surf Adventures
spots.description: A surf camp company that offers various surf camp options across the country for different budgets. They provide coaching-focused and party-oriented accommodation options.

mentions.videoTitle: Sri Lanka Surf Guide - 8 Tips To Know BEFORE You Go! 🇱🇰 (Surfing In Sri Lanka) | Stoked For Travel
mentions.quote: make sure you check out the crew of stoke surf Adventures they've got some awesome surf camp options all around the country for plenty of different budgets

spots.name: Lucky Surf House
spots.description: A budget-friendly surf camp option in Sri Lanka offering affordable accommodation for surfers.

mentions.videoTitle: Sri Lanka Surf Guide - 8 Tips To Know BEFORE You Go! 🇱🇰 (Surfing In Sri Lanka) | Stoked For Travel
mentions.quote: whether you're saying somewhere a little bit more budget friendly like lucky surf house

spots.name: Ticket to Ride Surf
spots.description: A mid-range surf camp that is the creator's personal favorite spot to stay. It offers a balance between comfort and surf coaching.

mentions.videoTitle: Sri Lanka Surf Guide - 8 Tips To Know BEFORE You Go! 🇱🇰 (Surfing In Sri Lanka) | Stoked For Travel
mentions.quote: all right through to somewhere like Ticket to Ride surface which is my personal favorite spot to hang out

spots.name: Outpost Weligama
spots.description: A coliving space with accommodation, co-working facilities, and an on-site cafe. Perfect for digital nomads and remote workers seeking community and longer-term stays rather than traditional hotels.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: I'm staying at this place called Outpost Weligama, which is basically a coliving space, which means that they have accommodation, but they also have like a co-working space.

spots.name: After Surf Cafe
spots.description: A rooftop cafe with stunning views and excellent food including poke bowls. The creator visited multiple times and praised the vibrant, amazing meals.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: At this place called After Surf Cafe. It's on the rooftop and this is the view. This cafe here, I've been here a couple of times and the food is amazing.

thingsToKnow: Some places don't accept cards; many only accept cash or charge a fee for card payments
It's good to carry US dollars and get cash converted locally

spots.name: Buddhist Temple with Fig Tree
spots.description: One of the oldest Buddhist temples in Sri Lanka, notable for having a sapling from the fig tree under which Buddha attained enlightenment, reportedly brought from that location.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: We're at a Buddhist temple. It's supposedly one of the oldest in Sri Lanka. The sapling from the fig tree under which Buddha attained enlightenment was supposedly brought over here and planted in this place.

spots.name: Koggala Beach
spots.description: A scenic beach area famous for stilt fishermen who fish from stilts. Popular activity includes trying stilt fishing yourself with local guidance.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: We've made it to Koggala. We're at the beach and something really popular to see in this area are stilt fishermen. So, they're basically like sitting on stilts and fishing.

spots.name: Martin Wikramasinghe Folk Museum
spots.description: A museum depicting rural life of Sri Lanka, built by the trust of prominent writer Martin Wikramasinghe who was from the Koggala region.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
mentions.quote: It's called Martin Wikramasinghe Folk Museum and it depicts the rural life of Sri Lanka. Martin Wikramasinghe was a very prominent writer in Sri Lanka and he was from this region Koggala.

spots.name: Wild and Sage

spots.name: Galle Fort

spots.name: The Kip
spots.description: A cafe in Ahangama with amazing food that the creator visited at least twice during their stay, indicating consistently great quality.

spots.name: Marshmallow Cafe

spots.name: Lighthouse Cafe

spots.name: Meewitha Restaurant
spots.description: A restaurant offering Sri Lankan plateau meals similar to thali with generous portions and delicious flavors combining Indian-style cooking with unique Sri Lankan twists.

spots.name: Hiriketiya
spots.description: A cute surf town about 1 hour from Weligama with numerous surf schools, shops, and cafes. Popular destination for surfing lessons and exploring a laid-back beach community vibe.

spots.name: Salt
spots.description: A cute cafe in Hiriketiya with amazing food and wildlife viewing opportunities. Notable for monkeys spotted nearby and good location for meals while in the surf town.

spots.name: La Luna

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️

spots.name: Sam's Place

spots.name: Tuana and Mirissa

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️

spots.name: Zippy
spots.description: A restaurant in Midama, 10-15 minutes from Outpost, that hosts the group's weekly family brunch. A nice-looking establishment though can be slow during off-season when staff is limited.

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️

spots.name: Mr. Sunil's Roti Shop

mentions.videoTitle: SRI LANKA TRAVEL VLOG 🇱🇰 3 Weeks Living in Weligama, Sri Lanka 🏖️🌴🌊🏄🏻‍♀️
